description: This is a PHP class 'MatcherRewardRepository' that manages database interactions related to 'MatcherReward' entities within the Goteo project. It provides methods for retrieving, counting, checking existence, persisting, and deleting matcher reward records, primarily involving SQL queries.

classes.name: MatcherRewardRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling database operations related to matcher rewards in the Goteo application.

methods.name: getListByMatcher
methods.description: Fetches a list of MatcherReward objects associated with a specific Matcher.

methods.name: getListByMatcherAndProject
methods.description: Retrieves matcher rewards associated with a specific matcher and project.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of rewards linked to a specific Matcher.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a reward is matched with a specific matcher.

methods.name: isRewardMatched
methods.description: Determines if a given reward is matched in the database.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Inserts or updates a MatcherReward record in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a MatcherReward record from the database.
